caption: Against a dark background, a wooden tabletop supports a clear cylindrical jar filled to about half its height with a dark amber liquid. A right hand emerging from a grey sleeve hovers open above the jar, fingers spread, while condensation beads the upper glass. The hand lowers, curling its fingers around the jar’s rim until it forms a closed grip. The jar remains seated on the table, its liquid surface flat, as the grip tightens and a dark edge appears at the jar’s top. The jar then tilts and blurs with motion, lifting clear of the tabletop while the hand shakes it rapidly. Inside, the dark liquid swirls into sloshing waves, then breaks into bubbles and froth as the shaking continues. The mixture gradually lightens into a pale, opaque, milky tan emulsion filling most of the jar, still held above the table by the moving hand.
